Arma Addon - 0.98 -v0.21
https://github.com/MycophobiaSC/Orky_Sector_Arma_Addon/releases/download/v0.21/Orky.Sector.-.Arma.Addon.0.21.zip

Older ver available on github if needed
Dependencies:
Lazy Lib
Magic Lib
Graphic Lib
Lunalib

Forum Post:
https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=29956.0

Features

A Mod that brings Orks from the 40k universe into the Persean Sector in a semi vanilla-friendly manner. This mod adds currently adds five ork factions (Death Skull/Evil Sunz/Bad Moons/Blood Axes/Goffs) with a series of both looted vanilla vessels and more original constructions, together with a corresponding set of Orky Hullmods, Weapons and LPCs.

The faction focuses on generally ramshackle ships that favors high speed, brutal close quarter combat and burst damage.

Many weapon and hullmods having powerful or strange effects but also potentially deadly downsides. The ork's strange psychic ability improves the combat ability and reliability of ships in great numbers, making their otherwise ramshackle warship more effective in great swarms.

There are also a simple system where you can beat up orks to obtain teef, allowing you to use them to exchange for various benefit from the ork clans, as well as a small quest, serving as basis for a longer chain we will eventually work on.

Some Design Thoughts
Turns out translating a bunch of mod gets one interested in trying to do some modding of their own. As a long time warhammer fan and ork player almost two decades, trying to bring the Orks to the Sector seems like a great excuse towards my limited spriting skills place to start!

There have been some excellent junker ship styles on the forums, and I thought to take a slightly different approach by focusing on the diversity of both fighting style and paintjob provided by the various Ork Clans in the setting, as a result this mod will be a bit more focused on bringing that aspect of Orky Kultur to the sector.

This is a Starsector mod first and foremost and I will not be strictly adhering to Battlefleet Gothic and 40k lore, and there will be some liberty in how I inject some proppa orkiness into the game, but I do hope you can find some good ol' orky fun within. This is our first starsector mod so any feedback and comment are appreciated as well. 😄

- Fixed a rare error that could occur intermittently while loading saves for some users

- Added support for forcing operations to spawn at colonized planets

pirate-mini-mod.discordPostHtml:
I always feel that once you hit a certain point you are no longer really surprised by pirates.
Their roster is limited and their few ships are either weak or just repaints of existing hulls. This alongside mod power creep often renders the faction a minor annoyance or time sink even in the mid game.

This is a mod meant to make pirates more unique, unhinged, and ambitious. As of now changes are simple but I plan to evolve the mod over time as I learn or get help.

Download: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1R5I_kJijUMsJBkFODWmfcNewr6rGjADJ
Forum Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=27893.0

releases.changelogNotes:
Fixed the bug where the courier was taking all your crew when transferring just some of them.
Courier fleets now need a transport as well to handle crew.
If the HQ is already at its max crew or marines when transferring them to the courier, they will be sold at base price instead.
Added the ability to send ships with the courier fleet back to HQ
Reworked the courier charter to be more useful, instead of having supply and request planets, it will now allow you to pick a charter route where the first one in line that needs something will send a courier fleet, this allows both courier fleets to be more consistent with actually moving stuff around.

Added to the Call Fleet ability, you can now pick to call a Patrol Fleet to join you, they will dock with the station and if all their ships are ready they will start a 7 day prep period, both fleets can be called but both fleets will need to be at the station and have all their ships before the 7 day prep time starts, once the 7 days is up they will lauch and orbit the station for a day before heading to your location, the 30 days doesn't start till they meet up with you, Patrol Fleets will need 2 Tankers and 2 Freighters to be eligible to be called, they can still be crewed with out them but won't be able to be called.

Mining and Salvage fleets where moved to the Fleet HQ but still require the Material Acquisition Hub to be build.

Reworked the cost of the Player HQ and all the modals.

The Manufactorium now produces all the items with out special items at 2x the cost, only exception to this is Heavy Armaments, Domestic/Luxury Goods which are 3x standard, 2x with corrupted and 1x with pristine and only produce a max of 50 per month.

Fixed a bug where the resupply and courier fleet would not head to you once in system making it where you had to find it, now it will travel to you in system as well.
Courier fleet can now have up to 5 freighters.

Cleaned up the main menu and added a line for what is being produced atm.

Bio-Dome no longer requires a Fusion Lamp to build but production is limited, added a new upgrade that adds the Fusion lamp to improve production, Fusion Lamp and Soil Nanites upgrades will return it to the old output.

Added all the changes that where suppose to be in the previous patches, messed up and was working on two different versions of the game.

Removed 2 Mining Fleets and added 2 Salvage Fleets to the MAH, They will launch and search for debris fields and derelict ships, they will ignore ships with guards.

Added a Winter Resort to the Resort.
VR Suites now give a bonus % based off the hazard rating of the planet over 100%.
Beach Resort now gives a bonus for cold, very cold and planets with no atmosphere that are also cold.
Winter Resort give bonuses to hot and very hot planets.

Fixed where you can now produce fighters at the HQ.

Reworked the Courier's mechanic. (Forgot to actually add it but made a better version.)
Couriers will now return to the HQ as soon as the screen is closed.
There is now a Charter option on the main menu that allows you to set supply colonies and request colonies for the courier.

If the player has the automated ship skill they can use automated ships in the patrol HQ.

Added a Shopping List feature that allows your trade ship to buy equipment and ships from the market they are visiting.

Removed 2 Mining Fleets and added 2 Salvage Fleets to the MAH, They will launch and search for debris fields and derelict ships, they will ignore ships with guards.

Added a Winter Resort to the Resort.
VR Suites now give a bonus % based off the hazard rating of the planet over 100%.
Beach Resort now gives a bonus for cold, very cold and planets with no atmosphere that are also cold.
Winter Resort give bonuses to hot and very hot planets.

Fixed where you can now produce fighters at the HQ.

Reworked the Courier's mechanic. (Forgot to actually add it but made a better version.)
Couriers will now return to the HQ as soon as the screen is closed.
There is now a Charter option on the main menu that allows you to set supply colonies and request colonies for the courier.

If the player has the automated ship skill they can use automated ships in the patrol HQ.

Added a Shopping List feature that allows your trade ship to buy equipment and ships from the market they are visiting.

Fixed a bug where the custom order screen would close once opening when used from the intel screen.

Fixed the Exchange offering things it shouldn't offer for both the weapons and the ship side.

Fixed Expeditions returning with things they shouldn't like models of ships and stations.

Reworked the mining fleets, they now launch when ready, they have a 4 day cooldown after each mining trip, they will now travel to a planet and mine, each day they add to the fleets total cargo hold and when full will return to the station, if the station's hold is full of the resources the system offers the fleets will hold off on launching until the hold goes lower then 8,000.

Added the ability to pause production in the Manufactorium.

Cleaned up text to make everything as clean and understandable as possible.

Removed the ability to use Capitals in the Resupply/Trade/Courier/Mining fleets. (Before updating make sure to remove any Capitals)

Added 2 lines in the income screen under player hq that shows the upkeep for marines and crew in the HQ.

Removed 2 Courier fleets and added a Trade Fleet.
Trade fleets consist of up to 10 freighters and 2 tankers, will load up excess resources and sell them to friendly markets but are less efficient then trading your self. (Limited to Frigates, Destroyers and Cruisers only.)

Renamed the Call Resupply fleet ability to Call Fleet that will open a menu that will allow you to pick between a Resupply Fleet and A Courier Fleet
The courier fleet will act like the resupply fleet but instead take items from you and ferry them to the HQ

Strategic Assembly will now start with 500,000 production credit limit and the Nanoforge will give a bonus of 100,000 for a Corrupted and 250,000 for a pristine, Gamma cores give a bonus of 75,000, Beta of 150,000 and Alpha 250,000 along with their other bonuses.

Added ships to the exchange and added the ability to store ships in the Agora for selling.

Expedition Fleets now will require 2 tankers and will leave the system targeting the nearest highest tier ruin planet with in 10ly of the HQ.

Added a button under the HQ report that allows you to place orders when not near the station.

Forgot to track changes so I might of missed some

Friendly stations in the system will now send out a SOS that will be added to a list, any active patrol fleets will book it to that station to help with defense before moving on to the next station that needs help, when the list is clear fleet will return to normal

Add different options to dedicated AI system, now offering 3 tires, Gamma, Beta and Alpha each offering a better reduction and credit pool increase per month.
Changed the bonuses for the corrupt and pristine forge in the strategic assembly and giving them a bonus to production pool income per month.

Made it where mining fleets will now target planets with resources that the HQ needs the most.

I know I fixed a few bugs but can't remember what they where. (Sorry)

Thinking of redoing the fleets but need your opinions, Was thinking of removing a Patrol fleet and turning it into a Strike Fleet that you can order to attack something and a Grand Defender Fleet that will allow you to build only 1 patrol fleet but have up to 30 ships making it more of a boss fleet.
Was thinking of removing 2 courier fleets as I personally don't often use more then two anyway but add a Trade Fleet that will trade excess wares from the station for you.
Was thinking of making the Expedition Fleets to be allowed to go to different systems with a increased chance of finding loot but also require you to fund the expeditions with credits, supplies and fuel. (Let me know what you think)

Forgot to add the fix for the fleets dying due to low CR, it's in this version now.

Fixed fleets being spawned as mothballed.

Fixed a bug where it would say it build the module but when you left the interaction screen it would go back to showing not being installed.

Added the HQ to a single line under the fleet in the income screen.

cleaned up text and made it more understandable.

Added a line to the intel report for Mining Fleets and what they brought back that month.

Added version checker support.(Actually this time, will fix change log when I have the time)

Added version checker support.

Fixed a bug where fleets where stuck at 0% CR and dying.

Added support for mods that add mining ships, added carriers and drone tenders to the list of acceptable ships, mining/carrier/drone tenders get a 2x mining power bonus.
(Courier/Resupply fleets can also use modded ships.)

Fixed a bug where if the fleet was destroyed and you uninstalled the bay you'd not get any ships back.

Cleaned up info text, fixed typos and removed personal notes.

Added fuel production via the installation of a Synchrotron Core.

Reduced the Bio-Dome output some more, now 600 Food and 300 Organics, Soil Nanites now give a flat 200 more of each when installed.

Removed the Combat Drone Replicator station upgrade(Make sure to uninstall it before updating) and now the colony gets a 0.50x bonus to defense and +1 Stability if you build the Military Hub.

Added a 500 Crew cost for the Resort.

Got the intel report to look cleaner and be more useful.

Training Expeditions now orbit for 8 days before moving on to a new planet and will prioritize planets with ruins first.

Added the ability to pick what ships you want to crew the bays with in the Expedition HQ

Added a Market Place upgrade the station upgrades, when build it will unlock a market that will sell weapons, wings and rarely blueprints and hullmods, it will allow you to sell your excess equipment, hullmods and blueprints but a random number will be picked between 0 and 1,000,000 and that is the amount that be able to be sold that month, there is a second inventory of the station where you place your items you want to sell and the pricey ones will be sold first, if you buy anything off the market it will be added to the total amount.

Working on a blacklist for things that mods add that shouldn't be in the market place.

Working on a new upgrade that will allow you to request a fleet via a ability to get Supplies, Crew and Fuel.

Will add mod support for items if there is a request for them.

Did general clean up of descriptions and info text.

Fixed not getting the ability when adding mod to existing save, tested it even with removing the mod, remember when removing to make sure to dismantle the station before saving and removing the mod.

Fixed the High tech version needing a beta and the Low tech needing a Gamma. (should of been the other way around)

Added a accessibility mechanic to the station that starts at 25% meaning you only earn 25% of the credits the Resort would be earning, at 100% you will gain the full amount of credits for the Resort and any % over that will give you a bonus, Added Station Upgrades to improve accessibility.
(The player skill Industrial Planning will now give a 15% accessibility bonus to the station.)

Added a new upgrade to the Military Paradigm that requires you to build it with ships that will let your crew and marines go on expeditions. (4 bays in total)
Fleets will actually spawn from your station using the ships you gave them that can not be attack and will go around the system orbiting planets for a while before returning to the station, if the planet has ruins there is a chance that they will return with weapons/wings/blueprints/special items and even ships.
(If the player has the skill Salvaging then there will be a improved chance to find rare stuff.)

Added info showing cost and production for things in the Manufactorium.

Reduced the Bio-Sphere as I found it was rivaling the production of a planet.

Install Nanoforge in the Strategic Assembly now lets you pick between corrupt and pristine instead of auto picking.

Added a better intel report under the "Personal" tab of the intel screen telling you where the station is and what it produced last month as well.

Marine XP gained from them training at the station will now be transferred to your fleet. (sense they are training under your style of leadership)

Added asteroid belts to the Materials Acquisition Hub, each belt now gives ore, rare ore and volatiles.

political-map.discordPostHtml:
Currently in pre-release. Requires LazyLib and LunaLib. Safe to enable mid-save, uninstalled via settings.

Install it via TriOS or by downloading KMLib (its dependency) and KMU (the mod itself).

The Political Map is the first among Sector Map Layers and focuses on populated colonies and their allegiances, with Faction, Alliance, and Claim views. It shows up primarily on the map screen and the intel screen, with a collapsible sidebar as its control interface.

Made compatible with Fast Rendering, Nexerelin (alliances), Random Assortment of Things (minimap replacement). Can play Bad Apple.

Bishop1664 made a short video showcase.

privateering-commission-overhaul.discordPostHtml:
A simple overhaul to faction commissions.
The goal of the mod is to add a few more features to commissions while making them feel less "passive" overall.

Latest Download: https://github.com/Lukas22041/Privateering/releases/latest/download/Privateering.zip
Forum Post: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=33914

Commission Rebalance
Vanilla commissions scale by level, with the formula being 20000 + (5000*level) , maxing at 95k credits per month.
This mod reduces the basic pay to a measly non-scaling 15k credits per month.
The catch is that certain maintenance costs, like supplies and officers, now have 50% of their upkeep covered by your faction.

Requisition Bonds
Requisition bonds are a new resource. They are accquired when fighting fleets hostile to your commission faction.
A bond is equal to 500 credits, but can only be spent by meeting with your commission supervisor.
The supervisor is a new NPC which has several options for spending bonds like custom production, hiring mercs and repairing d-mods.

Favorability
The mod adds a new major event, called Faction Favorability.
As you support the faction, you gain more favor with it, resulting in being rewarded with slight bonuses.

-Not compatible with AoTD - Questions of Loyalty 
-Works fine with other Ashes modules.

random-weapon-collection.discordPostHtml:
Adds a few ships and weapons I came up with.

If you have a good idea for something I should add, let me know.
Balance feedback is appreciated.
Feel free to ping me.

Contains: ##

Ships ##

Egret- Midline capital carrier very similar to the Heron
Onslaught (B)- Onslaught variant with a beam TPC. Does not spawn in NPC fleets/markets currently.
Conqueror- Midline battleship, fast but very poor rear arcs. Comes with 2 fighter bays.
Javelin- Midline cruiser with AAF. Main armament is 4 medium ballistics.
Polaris- Midline battlecarrier with reloading Harpoon launchers.
Viper- Midline frigate with AAF.
Barrage-Capital ship made out of station parts. Slow, but heavy firepower.
Viking -Missile frigate
Warhawk- Very mobile cruiser, based on the Falcon.
Hurricane- high tech frigate with Terminator drones.
Vulcan- cross between the Onslaught and Conquest.
Triumphant- broadside capital ship with heavy armor.

Weapons ##

Devastation- Large slot HE ballistic weapon. Will show up in mercenary fleets occasionally.
Mjolnir Heavy Cannon- Triple-barrel Mjolnir, good luck finding something with the flux to use this well.
Autopulse Beam- Designed as a shitpost, is just an Autopulse Laser that was turned into a beam weapon. Does not spawn in NPC fleets/markets currently.
Plasma Beam- Similar to the Autopulse Beam, but based on the Plasma Cannon. Does not spawn in NPC fleets/markets currently.
Tachyon Accelerator- Projectile variant of Tachyon Lance. Does not pierce shields.
Light Mjolnir- Single-barrel Mjolnir, fits in medium slots.
Heavy Positron Cannon- Hybrid large weapon. Probably needs more balancing.
Positron Cannon- Hybrid medium weapon.
Piledriver Heavy Railcannon- Large kinetic ballistic.
Harpoon Missile Battery-Large slot Harpoon launcher.
Phase Beam Battery- triple phase beam in a large slot. High damage output, bad range and slightly less flux efficient than the standard Phase Lance.
Flash HVM- Very maneuverable missile with a relatively short lockon range. Great against lighter ships, and comes in small, medium, and large sizes.
Onager Cannon- Fragmentation cannon, good fire rate but ineffective against armor or shields.
Hellfire Mortar- Deals heavy damage if it manages to hit. If.

Wings ##

Wildcat- DEM bomber
Solace- Energy "bomber"

Can be added mid-playthrough and should function correctly if done.

remove-trash-ships.discordPostHtml:
A very simple mod that reduces the player faction's hull_frequency for base_bp ships to 0.1.

Basically, once you acquire a blueprint package or two, default ships will almost never appear in your fleets unless you manually prioritize them.

Ships like the basic kite, hound, etc. might still appear if you only know one or two packages. That's because they belong to a category your fleets need and might not have have an alternative for. (Shuttles, tankers, cargo ships, combat freighters, etc.)

Safe to remove from your save*. The game will load the value from default player faction file (which is to say, no actual value at all, putting these ships on even footing with all other blueprints).

reverse-engineered-private-arsenal.discordPostHtml:
Ever wanted to copy that rare weapon or ship you found instead of hoping for a blueprint drop? Build a Reverse Engineering Hub on your colony. Deposit weapons, fighters, or ships into storage. Each day the hub researches one item. Once done, you get fifty copies to buy from an integrated Private Arsenal submarket at a configurable price.
The hub comes in three tiers. Tier 1 handles weapons, Tier 2 adds fighters, Tier 3 adds ships (but you only get their blueprints when improved). Assign an AI core for bonuses: it speeds up research AND cuts the Arsenal prices.
Requires LunaLib. Works with modded gear. Full source on GitHub. No credits needed.
Download: https://github.com/andrzejsokolowski/starsector-private-arsenal/releases/latest
Forum Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=35627.0

This mod is a complete rewrite of DarkQOL's private arsenal/reverse engineering industries. I opted to coalesce them into one thing.
DarkQOL's abandoned and buggy, so I fixed it up, changed the logic and balance, and gave it a small general feel update.
Most of the mod is configurable via lunaSettings.

ssmscontrollerex-controller-support.discordPostHtml:
Full controller support for Starsector. Currently supports Xbox 360, PS4, Nintendo Switch, and Steam Deck. Campaign support is nearly complete for the most common UI's, but for late-game stuff like colony management UI's, don't expect much.

Changelog:

 - Added support for character sheet tab
 - Added support for fleet tab
 - Added support for Refit tab (incredibly basic, mostly just a mouse emulator)
 - Tweaked support for crew/cargo tab so that navigating from it to the adjacent tabs works
 - Added support for map tab (mostly a mouse editor, but it does support toggling sector/system view)
 - Added support for the intel tabs (including support for the main Intel, planets, and faction sub-tabs)
 - Added support for the Command tab (same as Refit currently, just a mouse emulator)
 - On the main campaign view, added support for selecting ship abilities/hotkeys, the current ability is highlighted with a yellow reticle, and you press B to activate the selected ability.
 - Added support for various message boxes that show up throughout the game, for instance the one that shows in campaign view when supplies run low.
 - Tons of small little bugfixes that I can't hope to list

Download: https://github.com/katemonster33/SSMSControllerEx/releases/download/v1.3/SSMSControllerEx.zip

Add a mid-tech battle group. Having some vanilla-like ships. Having some special faction weapons, but all of these are build-in their ships.

Starsector Mod by Yisic/Diling
Proofread by Mycophobia

Requires Graphic Lib/Lazy Lib/Magic Lib/Nex

Lore

XXVII - Shakeles Garrison
Shackles Garrison is comprised of the remnants of the XXVII Battlegroup, disillusioned with human rule after being left adrift for an extended period of time after the Collapse, seeing themselves as abandoned by the rest of humanity. Their arrival in the Sector was originally marked by a willingness to collaborate, but the geopolitically volatile environment of the Sector caused them to be embroiled in significant conflict with both Tri-Tachyon Technology and the Hegemony. These conflicts resulted in the annihilation of the Garrison's capital planet and significant fleet losses, forcing the faction to retreat to a small star system outside of the Core Worlds.

The net effect of these conflicts was to transform the Shackles Garrison from a disillusioned, somewhat cynical, but fundamentally collaborative faction with a decently-sized military force into a civilization driven almost exclusively by revenge. Specifically, a cold, patient, seething determination to exact vengeance on those who ultimately killed billions of their people, after they had arrived in the Sector with cooperative intentions. For now, they were weak, beaten, unthreatening - but they would bide their time, marshal their forces, sharpen their blades - and then there would be hell to pay.

It will be better if you start your new run after you finish all XXVII missions. Because those missions will give you some reward.

ship-browser.discordPostHtml:
Do you have a chronic mod addiction that makes the list ships command produce several pages of console output? Do you like testing out ideas for fleets but hate flicking though the variant editor for 5 minutes straight adding smods? I do, and I have spent hours automating parts of these minor inconveniences.

Some commands include:

ShipBrowser
Opens a gui ship browser that's organised by mod and ship class. The gui opens after the console is closed.

CloneShip <shipNumber> [numberOfClones]
Creates a copy of a specified ship in the player fleet. "shipNumber" is the order that ships appear in the refit screen. For example the fifth ship from the top in the refit sceen would be ship number 5. "numberOfClones" is a number that defaults to 1 if not specified.

FindSystemsWithTags <manditory1stTag> [optionalAdditionalTags]
List the star systems with all of the tags specified in the arguments. A list of tags can be found in com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Tags of the StarSector API. Input the string that corresponds to the tag obtained by viewing Constant Field Values. Can be used to find hypershunts and remnants

AddDMods <shipSelection> <numDmods>
Adds "numDmods" dmods to the ships specified by "shipSelection". "NumDmods" is a number. "shipSelection" can be a number (eg. 5), a range (eg, 5-10) or the word all. The numbers in "ShipSelection" corresponds to the order ships appears in the fleet or refit screen. For example the fifth ship in the refit screen is ship 5.

A full list of commands can be found on the forum post. Note that some of the fleet editing commands don't work while the refit screen is open for some reason. No clue why

Some or all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:

speedup.discordPostHtml:
Warning: We strongly recommend setting your frame rate cap in data/config/settings.json to at least 120 to avoid AI and hit detection issues!

Ever wish the game would go by quicker while you're flying your lumbering Paragon up to the line of battle? Ever wanted to push "fast forward" while your fleet mopped up the remnants of an enemy fleet? Ever wanted to speed through a trivial Derelicts fight? This mod is for you!

Hold the middle mouse button and the game becomes 2x faster. You can also press the caps lock key to toggle fast mode at your leisure. The B button toggles the slow-down effect of phase systems.

The following are NOT RECOMMENDED for pitched battles due to causing problems with AI and hit detection: F3 applies a 6x multiplier, and control-capslock causes the game to run in as-fast-as-possible mode.

Controls are fully customizable by editing SpeedUp/data/config/SPEED_UP.json. You can even set custom time scaling factors on separate inputs, if you like.

Version 1.2.2 (April 7, 2025)
- Updated for Starsector 0.98a-RC7
- Improved the calculation for calculating dynamic speed multipliers

Version 1.2.1 (March 31, 2025)
- Updated for Starsector 0.98a
- Fixed a logical bug preventing dynamic changes in speed multipliers

starsector-audio-fixer.discordPostHtml:
A small patch that addresses an issue that has existed in the game for ages.

Usually when you're playing Starsector and for whatever reason your audio device changes (Blutooth headphones disconnect, wired earbuds unplug, you swap from integrated speakers to your brand new JBL, etc.) the game will lose all audio until you restart, this happens because the game does not handle audio device swapping, when you start the game it scans for the default audio device and sticks with it, if that ever changes the game keeps transmitting audio to a stale device that no longer exists.

This patch fixes that issue by upgrading the OpenAL in the game and using a proxy to properly communicate with Windows and handle any sound device changes so your Bluetooth headphones can lose battery and you wont have to wait 45 minutes for your toaster to load your 500 mods again.

Works with a regular starsector installation and Java 27 upgrades (Mikohime)

Download link: https://github.com/reaperyeah420-cpu/starsector-audio-fix
(The above includes a source code if anyone is skeptical of installing .dlls from strangers online)

releases.changelogNotes:
This release fixes a critical incompatibility between the French Language Pack and Nexerelin.

Until now, players running the French Language Pack alongside Nexerelin (with its dependencies LazyLib and MagicLib) experienced two separate crashes: one when loading the game, and another when starting a new game, where the Nexerelin faction selection screen failed to appear. In practice, this made the French Language Pack unusable for a large portion of the community, since Nexerelin is one of the most widely installed mods for Starsector.

Both crashes are now fixed. The French Language Pack is fully compatible with Nexerelin: the game loads correctly, new games start as expected with the faction selection screen, and all French translations remain intact.

If you previously had to choose between the French Language Pack and Nexerelin, you no longer have to. We recommend updating to v2.0.15.

stat-derived-ship-costs-the-kelly-blue-b.discordPostHtml:
"The Kelly Blue Book of Spaceships"

The most important immersion mod for any modded Starsector run. Ships are no longer priced by vibes, they are appraised by their actual hull stats, condition, rarity, logistics burden, and market channel.

Stat-Derived Ship Costs acts like a Kelly Blue Book for spaceships. It evaluates loaded ship hulls and replaces arbitrary market prices with stat-derived values that better reflect what a ship is actually worth in the Sector.

Powerful ships are not nerfed. The economy simply recognizes them. If a ship is trash, the market will reflect that.

That sleek destroyer might still look amazing, but the ugly frigate you used to ignore may suddenly reveal itself as the better buy! Especially when you realize you can deploy three of them for the same DP cost.

Features:

  • Stat-derived ship hull pricing
  • Highly Tunable
  • Positive Faction Relations give dynamic discounts
  • D-mod condition pricing
  • Open, military, and black market unique price behavior
  • Rarity, logistics, and market-context adjustments
  • Hull value report generation
  • Designed for heavily modded games with inconsistent ship pricing
  • Will flip your logic when composing fleets

Save Compatibility Notice

Safe to add to an existing save.
Safe to remove, but ship prices will return to normal after the mod is disabled and the game is restarted.

A full restart is recommended after updating.

stop-bloating-me.discordPostHtml:
StopBloatingMe

Lists every ship, weapon and fighter in your install from the main menu, and lets you blacklist the ones you don't want to ever see again.

Do you have 244 mods installed? Do you have 3294 ships? Do you need the 15th recolour of the Onslaught? No. Block it and never see it again.

Is there a weapon or fighter in your modlist so shit or overpowered that finding it for sale ruins the save? Block it from markets.
Unfortunately I cannot block it from spawning completely, so It still spawns on ships, so nothing breaks and nothing crashes.

What it does

Adds a DE-BLOAT button to the main menu. No campaign needed, no save to load.
Three tabs: Ships, Weapons, Fighters. Click a row to block it, click again to unblock.
Hover preview shows the sprite, so you can block by silhouette instead of trying to remember 3294 ship names.
Live search plus multi-select filters with counts, built from your installed mods: size, designation, design type, source mod, mount, role and tier.
Bulk block/unblock whatever the filter is showing. Filter to one mod's ships, one click, gone.

What blocking actually does

Ships are gone entirely — removed from every faction's blueprints, so they stop spawning in fleets, stop being stocked in markets, and vanish from the codex.
Weapons and fighters are gone from markets only — they still spawn on ships that were designed with them. That's deliberate: fully removing a weapon breaks every variant mounting it and crashes on load. This way nothing breaks.
Your storage is never touched. Only shops get swept.
Storage Saved per installation, not per save — curate once and every future playthrough inherits it. Nothing is written into a savegame, so it's safe to add or remove at any time, mid-save included.

Requires LazyLib. Open source, no credit needed. Claude Code built this anyway.

Forum: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=35850.0 Download: https://github.com/andrzejsokolowski/starsector-stopbloatingme/releases/latest

strikecraft-standalone.discordPostHtml:
Do you want to use mods that include strikecraft, but don't want to have the full suite of armaa's features, such as its faction and mechs, in your game?

Then this mod is for you! It includes the Strikecraft hullmod and absolutely nothing else from armaa, effectively satiating mods that normally have armaa as a dependency due to including strikecraft. This mod does use the original ID of the strikecraft hullmod as well so, presuming the mod in question doesn't rely on any other aspect of armaa, this mod should work as a substitute that you can just drop in and should work out the box.

Important: Do NOT run this mod alongside armaa, use one or the other. Besides there being no reason to do so as armaa contains everything in this mod to start with, the two will also crash the game if used alongside eachother.

I do strongly recommend still using armaa instead of this as it is an awesome mod, but to each their own.

All credit to Shoi for the original armaa.

takeshido.discordPostHtml:
Do you feel the need?

The need... for speed?

Then this is the mod for you! Formerly a part of the mod Epta, Takeshido is now back as its own new and improved standalone mod, featuring:
-Over 70+ cars from real life and iconic sources that work as both racecars and have custom AI for combat.
-1 faction with 3 decent planets, their own set of ships, an interesting system, and their own theme music.
-A full racing gamemode consisting of betting on races, participating in immediate races, and joining a multi track racing grand prix with a large cash payout for the winners.
-Over 25 replications of real life iconic racetracks that you can race around.

Wanna race? just install the mod, head to any world in the Meiyo system, and talk to any race coordinator via the colony's menu or its comms link to join an impromptu race, bet on a race, or join a tournament.
Or, if you're impatient you can get a teaser by starting the main menu mission "The Rapid and The Rambunctious"

This mod can be added mid save and the faction and whatnot will spawn as normal.
It should be compatible with Epta in the sense that it won't crash, however, I would not recommend using the two together.

releases.changelogNotes:
Human navies now open the war at full strength and win early ground victories. In testing they burned 10 hive worlds in the first two years, where before they burned one in five; the hive still grinds them down if the player stays out.

Hive fog of war
A strike no longer reveals where it came from. The struck faction gets a lead and sends scouting parties to sweep the systems around it. Sieges, task forces and contracts act only on hives someone has found.
The swarm scouts too: it only strikes worlds its Scouting Swarms have charted.
Fleet archetypes: 12 new Threat variants, and strike, garrison, seeding and scout swarms are each built to their own shape.
NPC navies
Depots fill from the war's supply (importers used to bank nothing once mobilised) and start full the moment a faction mobilises.
Sieges actually launch: staging bases bank toward the siege, and convoys carry full loads of marines, fuel and supplies.
Sieges sail at full strength and weigh the Defense Swarms first. A base the swarms outweigh posts a swarm bounty, paid per Threat ship by hull size.
Landings are sized to survive the hive's first counter-attack, with marines pooled from the faction's other bases. When the nearest base cannot pay for a siege, the next nearest sails instead.
Hunting forces: a base with no siege of its own hunts a bountied hive's Defense Swarms. Fleets from every base in reach muster outside the system and go in as one fleet. Allies answer a siege call with a hunting force.
Player
Hunt replaces Intercept: send a task force to hunt a hive's Defense Swarms from the board. Your hunting fleets collect swarm bounties on their own.
Raid the fortifications: a colony's Ground Defenses, Heavy Batteries, Patrol HQ, Military Base and High Command are on the Disrupt raid list at Heavy danger. Raids wear them down past the orbital floor, and every raid's days count in full. Committing many marines to one structure costs more against a strong garrison, so several shallow raids beat one deep one. Off with Nexerelin, whose own bombardment covers it.
The war board lists only the hive systems you have found, and stays off the intel list until you find the first.
Fixes
Help requests now withdraw and expire; Defend windows close.
Hive worlds no longer post survey, analyze or procurement missions.
A hunting force that never fights gets its fuel and supplies back in full.
A swarm out raiding or reinforcing keeps its slot at home, so garrisons no longer overshoot the cap.
Hives no longer found colonies in inhabited core systems.
NPC sieges bombard until their landing can survive the first counter-attack, and pool armaments as well as marines.
Siege landings, NPC and yours, are sized for the defences orbit can actually wear down: a hive without batteries no longer gets a landing too small to hold.
Hunting forces of hostile factions no longer meet at the same hive, and a force fights as one fleet (capped at 90 ships).
Hunts no longer spend what a base has banked for its own siege.
Your hunting fleets are no longer paid twice when you fight beside them; bounty standing comes once per battle.
Hunt is no longer offered on convoys.
Siege fleets no longer shuttle back and forth between worlds.
The disabled Aid/Defend tooltip names the real requirement: a military structure and a Waystation.
With LunaLib, the first launch moves Siege Max Fleets (10 to 25) and Mobilisation Stock (3 to 6) to the new defaults if they still hold the old ones; values you set yourself are kept.

Threat Incursion is now The Abyssal War. The mod id is unchanged, so existing saves keep working.

Ground war
Eradication is a ground campaign, not a decline timer: land marines, take the strata, kill the Fabrication Core.
Ground fronts push, dig in or withdraw; armaments burn per marine per day, so what a front carries is how long it lasts.
Fronts push the moment troops land at holding strength; a dug-in front stays dug in until the next landing.
Sieges fight for the orbit first. Bombardment wears fortification to a floor and no further - a front on the ground takes it the rest of the way.
Threat strikes land fronts of their own on inhabited worlds, dig in, then make a final push.
Colony defense is garrison troops times fortification, each worn down separately, with an orbital floor under the structures.
Marines arm over weeks, take casualties, count toward counter-attacks, and carry veterancy both ways with your fleet's marine pool.
Support and Defend fleet orders: hold the orbit, run the siege slice, or fight only while the front cannot hold.
A Defend fleet at the orbital floor can break up its own hulls into troops for the front.
Planetary shields buy real cover against orbital bombardment.
The hive scours an unopposed enemy front after three days.

Strategy layer
NPC factions enter war mode when the Threat strikes them; you mobilise or stand down yourself.
Every colony banks a visible reserve of marines, heavy armaments, fuel and supplies.
Convoys carry that stock physically - escort them, or let the swarm's raiders have them.
Fleet orders from the board: guard, stage, intercept, support, defend, siege, recall.
Guarding your own colony stages the fleet there: its strength counts at the host and folds into sorties.
Faction view shows any mobilised faction's colonies, reserves and fleets, with a totals row and a colour key.
Min / Med / Max load ladders on sieges, supply runs and convoy loads.
Recalled and expired fleets sail home and return their surviving cargo.
Sieges are leashed to the contested orbit; strays are recalled instead of chasing across the sector.

Player aid and outposts
NPC factions are autonomous now: you aid them, you do not command them.
Send Defend, Resupply, Reinforce or Strike from your own colonies, gated by a capacity ledger and reserve stock, earning standing on arrival.
Factions post their needs as ordinary missions - deliver by colony fleet, or in person at the dock.
Allies send each other aid by standing, without you.
Build an outpost over any uncolonised world, or take one free by ground victory. Dock at it for storage, or decommission it.
A later colony on that world inherits the outpost.

Economy
War reserves are the colony's real resource stockpile, not a separate hidden ledger.
Mobilised colonies carry the War Footing condition, so the war shows as genuine demand and a real shortage on the colony screen.
Depots cover the colony's own shortages before they fund anything else.
Convoys land as trade at the receiving colony.
Bases need a Waystation; NPC mobilisation builds them.

Escalation
Grudge and alarm: the swarm answers whoever hurts it most, and alarm speeds hive fabrication.
A ground victory draws retaliation from the nearest hive.
Coalition fleets answer a mobilised faction's call during a siege.
Defense Swarms detach to raid convoys, then return to their garrison.

Board
Ground Fronts table, per system, with order buttons on every front.
Per-fleet rows with Recall and Intercept.
Colony rows open vanilla's own colony screen.
Purge commissions removed; sieges launch from the faction view.
Tooltips rewritten: one line per fact, and every button says what pressing it does - or why it cannot be pressed.
The intel list row reads at vanilla's own size now, next to Colony Crises.

Testing
Instant War (LunaLib, Debug): stands up a mature sector-wide war on a fresh save in one toggle.

the-hagan-protestants-beta-in-need-of-pl.discordPostHtml:
A big old faction mod I've been hammering away at on and off for about a year now that's finally ready for some proper playtesting.

Features:

  • 28 Ships
  • 2 Fighter wings
  • 12 Weapons

+1 (Built in only)

  • 2 Hullmods

+2 (1 Built in only and a commissioned crews hullmod)

  • Full Nexerelion support

Diplo profile, corvus mode, weapon/ship/wing mining values and all

  • Commissioned crews support
  • 1 System w/ three planets

Verified via the modverse map to be in a unique location

  • and critically, 1 test mission equipped with all the included ships so you can get a feel for them without even starting a new game

The elevator pitch I'd use to describe the faction before it's even finished goes a bit like this:

  • Lore wise: Is a luddic church colony abandoned by said church during the second ai war, only narrowly saved by a hegemony relief fleet (I intend to package this event as a mission w/ the final mod) but not after years of their system being besieged by drone ships forced them to get creative industrially and in terms of their doctrine.
  • Gameplay wise: Funky mixture of high and low tech that I find fun. Lots of ballistic, hybrid, and energy hardpoints splattered throughout ~6 rough categories of ships. Generally being pretty strong and good quality if bought from the faction but appropriately expensive.

Is almost complete, it only needs the ship and system descriptions written which I'd like to do after someone other than me's played with these ships to hopefully get more fitting descriptions.
Feedback is not only appreciated but highly encouraged, please ping me in the appropriate channel or dm me with any comments or complaints (I'm mostly interested in collecting opinions on the ships doe ngl)

the-second-battlegroup.discordPostHtml:
The Second Battlegroup is an elite line of ships that can be found as derelict outside of the Core Systems (Like XIV Legion). But for gameplay purposes, their blueprint can also be found individually.

Their combat doctrine is "Adamantium Lance" which focuses on using overwhelming firepower to break through the enemy lines. They usually emphasize large, frontal weaponry while ignoring point defence, and some ships have slightly modified weapon arcs to perfect their job.

Their Battlegroup bonus is quite similar to the XIV, but the bonus and penalty are all increased. Overall, they are stronger than XIV ships. Due to the change in weapon systems, they usually cost 20-25% more DP compared to their vanilla counterparts and cost 3x as much (XIV ships cost 1.75x). Auxiliary ships have lower bonuses and less radical restructuring, so they only cost 1.5x as much.

thorough-system-scan-was-system-wide-sen.discordPostHtml:
A mod that allows player fleet to scan entire star system at the cost of volatiles CR and time.
Made by Nitori_Tachyon
Fossic post: https://www.fossic.org/forum.php?mod=viewthread&tid=15140&extra=page%3D1
Forum link:https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=32638.0
Github link:https://github.com/SaltyKarl/Thorough-System-Scan/tree/EN
Requires both LunaLib and LazyLib
the rest is English translation of the Fossic post

System Wide Sensor Scan

Adds an initially available campaign ability that allows the player to perform a System Wide Sensor Scan after a number of prerequisites have been met in order to discover salvage-worthy objects in the current system and temporarily have a view of all fleets in the system .

The prerequisites are as follows:

Fleet sensor strength of at least 1000 (Can be adjusted via LunaLib).
Have enough volatiles in the cargo bay (see later for numerical calculations)
Be in the scanning position of the current system (see later for definition)

Skill effects are as follows:

-Consume a certain amount of volatiles
-Finds and marks salvageable objects across the system
-Temporarily obtains detailed information on the location and composition of all fleets in the system (from about three-quarters of the way through the end of the scan).
-Player fleets are highly visible and limited in movement speed during skill activation.
-Reduces the readiness of several ships in the fleet that provide sensor strength (see later for details).
-Reports the expected number of special items (including AI cores, ship blueprints, fighter wing blueprints, weapon blueprints, ship insertion blueprints, colony industrial specials, etc.) carried by all salvageable objects in the system at the completion of the scan, which may deviate slightly from the actual value (can be turned off in LunaLib)

tinyverse-the-wanzer-age.discordPostHtml:
With the introduction of Diable Avionics into the sector and their military successes thanks to reintroducing the long abandoned technology of Wanzers, giant piloted mechanized robots capable of fighting both in-planet and out in the vacuum of space, showcased that it was time to consider the era of dominance of the spaceship and fighters had come to an end.
Factions all over the sector have scrambled to bring back old, forgotten relics out of the dusty hangars where they had been forgotten. Others have used their ample monetary resources to acquire Wanzer blueprints and schematics from both legal and more illicit means, and others have straight-up used their vast production powers to jumpstart their Wanzer development programs. A new arms race has begun.
Far from the core, mysterious forces noted these developments, and machines of eras past awakened in response. Binary messages spread across the sector's edge with one order: create a response, and new unspeakable things crawled out from dark shadows in the abyss.
The age of the Wanzer had begun.

Content:

This mod adds a large variety of Wanzer frames wings to all vanilla factions for both players to fight and utilize! It also adds unique Ace pilot Wings that can be found as rare bps.

  • 3 Unique Mass-production Wanzer variants for The Diktat, The Luddic Path, and Pirates

Ever feel like your Luddic faithful are just too picky? Worlds that are harsh, polluted, or missing a few farms shouldn’t ruin a colony’s harmony?

This mod lets your Luddic populations tolerate things they normally wouldn’t:

Harsh or uninhabitable worlds? They’ll make do.

Dardan Kato’s policies trying to suppress them? Not a problem anymore.

Pick what the faithful will tolerate. Keep it subtle, or disable the Heavy Industry factor entirely if you want them to ignore all industrial hubs.

Your colonies, your rules, your Luddic faithful thriving despite all the things that normally wouldn’t fly.

UNGP and Nex support.

Traverser Association is an organization built by outcasts from another world in hopes of survival. Before this, they were a large mercenary band working for the independents league. As their power grew, they begin to settle systems they have discovered by chance, and through integration of their survey findings ands technologies of various worlds, they built their worlds into a real fortress. From there, they built an association formed by other Traversers and like-minded individuals. A core institution called [Traverser Design Bureau] guide this faction forward. As an extremely xenophilic faction, they are welcoming and warm, but also bound by strict regulations. As long as you follow their laws, they will welcome your arrival.

What can be certain is that the association is providing special warships and weapons to reputable clients.

Faction Feature
Most ship have fairly strong shield resistance with weaker armor. They focus on Missile Strike and Carrier Strike. Now, you can modify their built in basic hull mods to further change their fighting style in a flexible manner.

Adds a faction with their own unique line of ships and support drone ships, together with a series of weapons and hull mods, as well as a few minor quest line.

tri-ceti.discordPostHtml:
I decided to post it on the discord, so more people get to test the mod and potentially help me fix more. And if anyone likes it, even better.

The mod adds 3 small factions to the game in the bottom right of the sector, always bordering the Abyss as their position is relative to the sector size. They are different in style and playability. Cetudan has fast carriers with no hull or armor. Cetora has salvaging ships with a healing drone 'harvesting' enemies in combat and reduced maintenance cost outside of combat. Cetevska has bioships healing constantly like the skill Combat Endurance but with no cap. To counteract that, they have increased crew casualties.

Link to the forum page: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=35831.0

truly-automated-ships.discordPostHtml:
This mod changes automated ships so that they use less automated points when outfitted with an AI core officer, at the cost of reduced operational time.

In the vanilla game, AI officers increase the "automated ship points" of the ship they're attached to, and to me it doesn't make too much sense. If your automated fleet relies on the computing power of the rest of the fleet to coordinate itself - and that's why having too many automated ships leads to a decrease in maximum efficiency for all of them - then grabbing a tonne of GPUs and stitching them together with a ship should actually lift some of the weight from your regular ships, not add even more!

With this mod, when you slap a supercomputer on a hull, it will actually make the ship more autonomous, and decrease its "automated ship points," leaving you with the ability to increase the size of your automated fleet even more! But beware: all of this added computing power will be a huge drain on your resources. After all, you wouldn't expect a giant AI core with the capacity to manage entire planets to be easy to sustain, would you? The good news is that small ships will be reasonably cheap, but as hull size increases, so do operational requirements.

Changelog:
2.0
Removed the previous downside for AI cores on automated ships (increased supply maintenance costs). It wasn't fun, just boring
Added downside of increased CR cost for deployment
Added downside of reduced PPT
Added downside of increased CR consumption during combat after PPT has expired
When using this mod on a preexisting savefile, you'll need to remove all cores that you already have on your ships and then put them back in. Otherwise, the game won't update their CR according to the mod. If you already have some cores integrated into ships by the time you install this mod, that ship's CR calculation will stay bugged. There's nothing I can do at the moment.

unofficial-new-game-plus.discordPostHtml:
New game cycle

  1. This mod to some extent makes up for the position of the previous old mod, SaveTransfer. When a player reaches the max level, he/she can record a saving point through the UNGP menu (there is only one saving point in all saves, which could be overwritten). The saving point will save your current credits, blueprints (other than the factory), and the current game cycle number (the new save's game cycle number will be "1").
  2. After that, you can start a new game. If you open the UNGP menu within 1 day, you can inherit the saving point, basing on the background you choose, inherit 0~100% of the credits and blueprints , and get extra bonus like skills, skill points and story points.

Specialist Mode

  1. From the second gamecycle, players can choose to enter the Specialist Mode.
  2. The specialist mode is divided into 4 levels: Gamma, Beta, Alpha, Omega.
  3. The selection rules have a maximum number of rules, which increases with the specialist difficulty level.
  4. Specialist mode offers two types of rules: positive rules and negative rules.

Positive rules: consume Cost points and provide you with different benefits for the rest of the game.
Negative rules: providing Cost points to add heavy obstacles to your game
Specialist mode can only be enabled if the total number of Cost points is greater than or equal to 0 and the number of rules is greater than the specified value.

  1. Specialist mode can change rules once a year, once in the beginning by default. However, the specialist level could not be changed during the game.

vexlia-s-faster-devstart.discordPostHtml:
Small QoL utility mod to add fast start options right on the new game creation screen and get to sector generation in one click. Created mostly for modders who need to reload the game a lot.

Current list of features (as of version 1.5b)

Name autosetting - Mod autosets character name, which allows to progress from character screen right away.

New fast start right on character creation screen

  • 2 devmode fast starts for vanilla
  • 2 devmode fast start for Nexerelin
  • 1 fully user customisable sequence start, defined in mod's Lunalib settings.

Devmode associated features:

  • Auto Devmode on app start - Alternative to Lunalib hotkey or changing boolean directly
  • Auto Devmode on Campaing load - Activates devmode on any campaigh load
  • Safe devmode - Anti-crash feature, disabling devmode for a moment when game saves, proven to remove crashes for AotD)

For more detailed description check forum:
https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=34394.0

vulpoids-lost-project.discordPostHtml:
https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=29929.0

Officially supports Starsector v0.98!

I want you all to praise - a java coder who made all my feature requests possible! I would also want all of you to compliment his writing. It was incredibly pleasant for someone to write down my lore and ideas so well on proper, gramatically and aesthetically sound English. Without him this mod wouldn't be possible!

ADDITIONS:

Vulpoids are now their own Persons!
Vulpoids characters now use their own custom class, allowing for modular portraits with configurable backgrounds, fur colors, hairstyles, and outfits!
Outfits can be switched between in-game! They'll still wear space suits if the job calls for it.
Customizable elements are specified in JSON files, making it easy to add your own!
NOTE: This was a delicate change to implement, and there's a chance that there's bugs or mod interactions that I was unable to catch. Always back up your saves when updating mods, and let me know if you encounter anything.

A new fur color, two new hairstyles, and new outfit colors.

warroom.discordPostHtml:
Tracks every war in the Sector in one Intel screen entry.
v0.14.0 for Starsector 0.98a-RC8

  • Hostilities: every active war. Who leads, who is gaining, battles, captures, losses.
  • War reports: event log, turning points, battle locations, strength.
  • Archive: timeline of all wars, every event, Sector news.
  • Faction pages: one faction's or alliance's wars and record.
  • Standings: factions and alliances ranked by colonies and territory.
  • Briefing: how war weariness, peace and the war score work.

Requires: LazyLib, Nexerelin
Saves: Records start at install. For the full history, start a new save. Add or remove anytime (removing deletes its records).

Add a mid-tech battle group. Having some vanilla-like ships. Having some special faction weapons, but all of these are build-in their ships.

Starsector Mod by Yisic/Diling
Proofread by Mycophobia

Requires Graphic Lib/Lazy Lib/Magic Lib/Nex

Lore

XXVII - Shakeles Garrison
Shackles Garrison is comprised of the remnants of the XXVII Battlegroup, disillusioned with human rule after being left adrift for an extended period of time after the Collapse, seeing themselves as abandoned by the rest of humanity. Their arrival in the Sector was originally marked by a willingness to collaborate, but the geopolitically volatile environment of the Sector caused them to be embroiled in significant conflict with both Tri-Tachyon Technology and the Hegemony. These conflicts resulted in the annihilation of the Garrison's capital planet and significant fleet losses, forcing the faction to retreat to a small star system outside of the Core Worlds.

The net effect of these conflicts was to transform the Shackles Garrison from a disillusioned, somewhat cynical, but fundamentally collaborative faction with a decently-sized military force into a civilization driven almost exclusively by revenge. Specifically, a cold, patient, seething determination to exact vengeance on those who ultimately killed billions of their people, after they had arrived in the Sector with cooperative intentions. For now, they were weak, beaten, unthreatening - but they would bide their time, marshal their forces, sharpen their blades - and then there would be hell to pay.

It will be better if you start your new run after you finish all XXVII missions. Because those missions will give you some reward.

the-orbiting-spoon-a-space-diner-officer.discordPostHtml:
link: https://github.com/starsector-mods/orbiting-spoons
forum thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=35988.0

Overview

The Orbiting Spoon is a lightweight, text-based roleplay and campaign layer mod that adds interactive space diners to markets and spaceports across the Persean Sector.

Instead of treating spaceports as just refueling menus, take a breather between bounties and hyperspace storms to grab a hot meal and check in on your fleet.
---

Features

  • Sit Down for a Meal

Visit The Orbiting Spoon at any civilized spaceport to order regional food and drinks.

  • Faction-Specific Diners & Menus

Menus and atmospheric descriptions dynamically adapt to who controls the market:

  • Sindrian Diktat – Butter-poached Volturnian lobster tail and spiced fuel-skewers beneath crimson banners of the Supreme Executor.
  • The Hegemony – Commissary iron stew, thermal rations, and bitter navy chicory coffee under cold fluorescent lights.
  • Tri-Tachyon – Prime vat-grown synth-steak, nutrient gel matrices, and "Phase-Shift" nootropics in a glowing automat.
  • Luddic Church – Pilgrim's Hearth harvest pie, fresh sourdough bread with salted butter, and spiced Gilead cider.
  • Luddic Path – Austere root mash with salt-mutton, bitter turnip broth, and herbal tea under flickering bare bulbs.
  • Pirates & Fringe Stations – Glowing bioluminescent fungal goulash, charred ribs, and "Reactor Leak" moonshine in a grimy dive.
  • Persean League – Archon's mezze skewer platter, saffron rice with crispy duck, and spiced citrus aperitifs.
  • Frontier & Independent Ports – Retro vinyl booths serving loaded spacer's stew, double waffles, and black "Engine-Joe" coffee.

adds an lpc editor that allows you to edit your wings to put custom weapons on it
to edit a wing you need to have a few conditions respected:
the wing must be whitelisted
the button is only added to carriers
you need to have weapons in your cargo
you must have an lpc retool chip can be found at any size 4+ market
to edit wings open the editor by pressing the lpc editor button this will bring you a ui where you can select the wing you want to edit wings are ordered in bay order
select weapon tab and choose a slot to edit only weapons in your cargo are considered
once youre done with your changes pressing save will save it allowing you to use it across your campaign and your other saves
